_status: DRAFT v0 - ASG-012, unapproved. Transition and retry rules are a proposal; the Blueprint (7.2) fixes the six minimum statuses and says transitions and retry rules must be defined.
rules: Every retry reuses the same operation ID / idempotency key.
A timeout after a possible server commit is retried with the same key; the server returns the recorded result and never applies the operation twice.
Expired authentication pauses the whole queue (operations stay 'pending'); it is not a per-operation failure. Resume after re-authentication.
'failed' is terminal and stays visible with the server's reason; a corrected action is a NEW operation linked to the original. Nothing is silently discarded.
An operation whose dependency is failed, conflicted or needs_attention stays 'pending' with a recorded blocked reason.
Retry timing: exponential backoff with jitter; maximum attempts and delays are implementation parameters to be fixed in the sync ADR (not decided here).
